purpose: Document distinct English/local-language search evidence, first-party local custody scope, direct anonymous route results and geometry-only limits.
assessment: HM Land Registry’s official INSPIRE Index Polygons download supplies a Portsmouth City Council local-authority ZIP. The GML contains 65,055 features; at the unchanged WUP point one full source polygon (INSPIREID 30222163) covers the point. The layer represents indicative extents/positions of registered freehold properties, not a complete legal cadastre. In a bounded 400 m × 400 m EPSG:27700 window, 112 complete geometries were valid and 29 pairs had positive-area overlaps above 0.01 m² (largest 194.723 m²); the WUP-covering feature itself overlaps another index polygon by 0.469 m². This is positive source geometry with a native-topology runtime hold, not evidence of no coverage. No owner/address data were queried or retained; native overlaps block enabling a non-overlapping runtime parcel model.
registryAssessment: HMLR offers a named Portsmouth local-authority INSPIRE Index Polygons file. It contains one complete polygon at the exact WUP point, limited to indicative registered freehold property extents/positions. The local 400 m native geometry audit found overlaps, so runtime is held.

officialPrimarySources.observation: City confirms that from 28 April 2022 statutory local land charge searches are only available through HMLR; city no longer provides that public service. CON29 enquiries remain an application workflow.

Privacy notice says HMLR serves the migrated register using information supplied by the council; city local role is limited to update/source-data custody for local charges, not cadastral parcel boundary publication.
Official index includes Portsmouth Local Land Charges dataset; statutory charge extent is not legal parcel cadastre geometry.
Official dataset page lists a local-authority download for Portsmouth City Council, describes indicative position/extent of registered freehold property and provides dataset under OGL.
Portsmouth ZIP downloaded through the official public link. GML EPSG:27700 yielded one full polygon covering the exact WUP point, INSPIREID 30222163.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official indicative registered-freehold index polygons are public and the WUP locator is covered. Independent native EPSG:27700 audit of112 full polygons confirms29 overlap pairs (>0.01m²), including the point-covering polygon. These source extents cannot be admitted as exclusive ground parcels without altering the source or representing overlap explicitly.

rootReview.decision: Public geometry verified; runtime held for source-native overlapping index extents. This is runtime-model incompatibility, not an invalid-source or missing-data finding.
